headline: EY Nigeria audit committee summit to examine emerging reporting risks
summary: EY Nigeria is convening audit committee members, board leaders, and regulators to examine emerging corporate reporting risks and compliance standards.
why: Enhanced corporate governance and risk reporting standards directly impact corporate transparency and compliance costs for listed entities in emerging markets.
